document_strings: I recall you refused To go to sleep
Grandma's Golden Book that she bought for 25¢
You are still An Avid reader
At P.T.A meetings I begged your Teachers To help improve your handwriting
At age 5 you had your first accordion lesson
lessons later Teacher Mr. Matos booked you in Carnegie Hall
You won prizes in Prospect Park, Central Park & other local competitive prizes
Do you know where your accordion is ?
You also played at your Bar Mitzvah and Uncle Lenny's Bar Mitzvah
